parameters.name: annual_revenue
parameters.description: Annual revenue of each candidate restaurant

parameters.name: purchase_cost
parameters.description: One-time purchase cost of each candidate restaurant

parameters.name: incompatible_pairs
parameters.description: Set of incompatible unordered restaurant pairs

variables.name: purchase_decision
variables.description: Binary decision indicating whether each restaurant is purchased

constraints.name: budget_limit
constraints.description: The total purchase cost of selected restaurants must not exceed the available budget.

constraints.name: pairwise_mutual_exclusion
constraints.description: For each incompatible pair \((i,j)\in\mathcal{P}\), at most one of the two restaurants may be purchased.

objectives.name: maximize_total_annual_revenue
objectives.description: Maximize the total annual revenue generated by the selected restaurants

final_objective.description: Maximize the total annual revenue generated by the selected restaurants over the single planning horizon.
